description: Configuration template for selecting and configuring the method used to create the Step 2.4 knowledge graph. Only the method defined in selected_method is executed.

method_1_syntactic_graph_traversal.name: Syntactic Graph Traversal
method_1_syntactic_graph_traversal.description: Structural extraction method based on RDF graph traversal. It starts from the alert node and follows RDF connections up to a configurable depth.

start_node.description: Initial RDF resource used as the traversal root.

max_depth.description: Maximum number of traversal hops from the start node.

include_outgoing_triples.description: Include triples where the selected node is the subject.

include_incoming_triples.description: Include triples where the selected node is the object.

include_node_closure.description: Include all direct triples associated with each selected resource.

ignored_predicates.description: Predicates ignored during traversal and extraction.

method_2_ontology_slicing.name: Ontology Slicing
method_2_ontology_slicing.description: Ontology-oriented extraction method centered on the semantic signature of the alert.

alert_node.description: Alert resource used to identify the ontology signature.

signature_predicate.description: Predicate used to collect D3FEND resources linked to the alert.

include_alert_node.description: Include the alert resource and its direct triples in the module.

include_signature_resources.description: Include D3FEND resources obtained from the alert signature.

include_class_hierarchy.description: Include class hierarchy triples related to selected resources.

include_outgoing_triples.description: Include triples where selected resources are subjects.

include_incoming_triples.description: Include triples where selected resources are objects.

include_node_closure.description: Include all direct triples associated with each selected resource.

max_depth.description: Maximum number of expansion hops from the signature resources.

class_hierarchy_predicates.description: Predicates treated as ontology hierarchy or class definition relations.

ignored_predicates.description: Predicates ignored during slicing and extraction.

method_3_full_global_baseline.name: Full Global Baseline
method_3_full_global_baseline.description: Control-group method in which no modularization or filtering is performed.

copy_full_graph.description: Copy the full knowledge graph unchanged.
